attchmntText: International Conveyors Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: International Conveyors Limited submitted a newspaper publication regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The publication was published on November 14, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company also enclosed the copy of the publication for the exchange records. Additionally, Duroplastics Limited published its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Alliance Udyog Limited published its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Paschim Bardhaman Zilla Parishad issued corrigendum notices for e-NIT No.17 and No.18 of 2026-2027 dated November 13, 2026. The Executive Engineer, Bidhannagar IT Division, PWD, invited quotations for temporary IT infrastructure work at Purulia Circuit House, with the last date for submission being November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: International Conveyors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Re-Appointment of  Ms. Jayanthi Talluri as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. January 27, 2027.
voiceSummary: International Conveyors Ltd has placed before shareholders the re-appointment of Ms. Jayanthi Talluri, DIN 09272993, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The Board of Directors approved this proposal during its meeting held on November 13, 2026. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The second term will be for five consecutive years, commencing from January 27, 2027, and ending on January 26, 2032. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee recommended this re-appointment. There will be no change in the constitution of the Board committees due to the immediate re-appointment upon the expiry of her current term. Ms. Talluri has over 28 years of experience in legal practice and corporate counsel roles. She is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the company. She is not debarred or disqualified from being appointed as a Director by regulatory authorities.

attchmntText: International Conveyors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: International Conveyors Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also proposed the re-appointment of Ms. Jayanthi Talluri, DIN 09272993, as Non-Executive Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years commencing January 27, 2027. This re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Standalone revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was 7678. Standalone profit after tax for the same period was 1120. Consolidated revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was 8242. Consolidated profit after tax for the same period was negative 68. The financial results have been reviewed by independent auditors G. P. Agrawal & Co.
